mapper.select: SELECT MAX(id) FROM tc_money_ledger WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant}
SELECT id FROM tc_money_ledger FORCE INDEX(ix_money_ledger_scan) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id>#{after} AND id<=#{upper} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN l.id AS ledger_id,l.ledger_no,l.entry_type,l.amount,l.currency,r.receipt_no,l.refund_no,r.order_id,r.disposition, r.provider_transaction_no,h.provider_refund_no, CASE WHEN l.entry_type='RECEIPT' THEN r.provider_paid_at ELSE h.provider_succeeded_at END AS provider_occurred_at, CASE WHEN l.entry_type='RECEIPT' THEN r.confirmed_at ELSE h.confirmed_at END AS confirmed_at FROM tc_money_ledger l FORCE INDEX(PRIMARY) JOIN tc_payment_receipt r ON r.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND r.id=l.receipt_id JOIN tc_payment_attempt a ON a.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND a.id=r.attempt_id LEFT JOIN tc_payment_refund_hold h ON h.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND h.refund_no=l.refund_no AND h.receipt_id=l.receipt_id WHERE l.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.channel_id=#{channel} AND (l.entry_type='RECEIPT' OR h.state='SUCCEEDED') AND l.id IN #{id} ORDER BY l.id
